fine_lines.title: tired vs sleepy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tired = متعب، تحتاج إلى راحة (مثلًا بعد الرياضة). sleepy = نعسان، تريد أن تنام.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Tired = you need rest (after work or sport). Sleepy = you want to sleep.

examples.sentence: I'm tired because I went jogging.
I'm sleepy because I couldn't sleep last night.

fine_lines.title: hungry vs full
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hungry = جائع تريد الطعام، وfull = شبعان بعد الأكل. وكلمة thirsty = عطشان تريد الشرب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hungry = you want food. Full = you ate enough. Thirsty = you want a drink.

examples.sentence: I'm really hungry. Can I have some?
I ate the sandwich. Now I'm full.

fine_lines.title: I'm tired / I feel tired / I'm feeling tired
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصيغ الثلاث صحيحة ولها نفس المعنى تقريبًا: I'm tired / I feel tired / I'm feeling tired. ومع he/she: He's tired / He feels tired / He's feeling tired.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All three are correct and mean almost the same. With he/she: he's, he feels, he's feeling.

expressions.example: How are you feeling, Sian? I'm tired.

expressions.meaning_en: an informal way to say how are you

expressions.example: I have tickets for the match. I'm so excited!

expressions.meaning_en: asking for the reason of a feeling
expressions.example: Why are you tired? Because I went jogging.

expressions.phrase: Because I went jogging this morning.
expressions.example: I'm tired because I went jogging this morning.
I'm sleepy. I couldn't sleep last night.

expressions.phrase: That drink looks great! Can I have some?
expressions.meaning_ar: هذا المشروب يبدو رائعًا! هل يمكنني أن آخذ قليلًا؟
expressions.example: That drink looks great! Can I have some? I'm really thirsty.
Can I have some? Sure! Here you are.
Hey! That's mine! I wanted that sandwich.

grammar.title: Talking about feelings: be / feel / be feeling
grammar.explanation_ar: نعبّر عن الشعور بثلاث طرق: I'm + صفة، أو I feel + صفة، أو I'm feeling + صفة. ومع he/she: He's excited / He feels excited / He's feeling excited.
grammar.explanation_en: Three ways: be + adjective, feel + adjective, be feeling + adjective. With he/she: he's / he feels / he's feeling.
examples: How does Tim feel? He's excited.
How is Sian feeling? She's feeling tired.

grammar.title: Why ...? Because ...
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن السبب بـ Why؟ ونجيب بـ Because + جملة.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask for a reason with Why? Answer with Because + sentence.
examples: Why are you tired? Because I went jogging this morning.
Why are you scared? Because there's a ghost outside!
She's sad because she wanted that sandwich.

grammar.title: looks + adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم looks + صفة لنقول كيف يبدو الشيء: That sandwich looks delicious.
grammar.explanation_en: Use looks + adjective to say how something seems.

questions.question: You want a drink. You are ...
You ate a big lunch. Now you are ...
"There's a ghost outside!" How does Georgie feel?
Which sentence is NOT correct?
questions.explanation_en: It needs is: She's feeling tired.

questions.question: "Why are you sleepy?" Choose the best answer.
choices: Because I couldn't sleep last night.

questions.question: Someone eats your sandwich. You say: "Hey! That's ___!"
"How's it going?" is ...
choices: a way to ask the time
an informal way to say how are you
a way to ask for food
